Privacy Policy

Last updated: 7 August 2026

1. Information we collect

FRALEN CRM may store information entered by an authorised shop user, such as customer name, mobile number, email, address, order details, prescription-related shop records, products, purchases, payments and expenses.

2. How information is used

Information is used to operate the CRM, manage shop records, generate reports, process orders and provide the features requested by the shop.

3. Account privacy

Shop data is intended to remain associated with the relevant account. Users should keep their login credentials private and should not share passwords.

4. Third-party services

The application may use hosting, authentication, database, analytics or messaging services. Their own policies may apply to information processed by those services.

5. Data security

Reasonable technical and organisational measures should be used to protect account and shop information. No online service can guarantee absolute security.

6. Contact

For privacy questions, contact FRALEN at mdnasrullah911@gmail.com.

Terms of Use

Last updated: 7 August 2026

1. Use of the service

FRALEN CRM is provided as a shop-management tool. Users are responsible for entering accurate information and using the service lawfully.

2. Account responsibility

The account owner is responsible for account access, passwords and activity performed through the account.

3. Business records

Users should maintain appropriate backups of important business information. CRM records should not be treated as a replacement for legally required accounting, tax or statutory records unless independently verified as suitable.

4. Availability

Features may be changed, improved, interrupted or discontinued when necessary. Service availability cannot be guaranteed at all times.

5. Contact

Questions about these terms can be sent to mdnasrullah911@gmail.com.
